data.name: Nasooh
data.gender_notes: Nasooh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nasooh is a name of great historical significance in Islam. It is the name given to the Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) by his father, Ya'qub (Jacob), as he was the tenth son and the apple of his eye. The name Nasooh is derived from the Arabic word 'nasaha' which means 'to support, help, or sustain'. The story of Prophet Yusuf is a powerful reminder of God's love, mercy, and protection, and the name Nasooh is a testament to these divine qualities.
